entry.title: Should wallets default to Taproot or SegWit receive addresses while some services still reject bc1p?
entry.summary:
The update reflects the removal of Paxful and an adjustment to reference Binance.com. Efforts were made to locate reliable information about Binance.us, but no authoritative sources could be found to support an update for that platform. It is also noted that Binance.us may operate with a different backend infrastructure compared to Binance.com.
Requests for further updates have been made, inviting others to share any additional relevant changes that should be documented or incorporated.
